title: Unique localization of the normalized strict scalar tensor comparison
statement: Fix l,E,L,iota,W and coefficient system calculi SE,SL [def-pur-scalar-extension-tower-data]. The strict normalized sigma has a unique derived natural isomorphism SE.systemClosed.tensor followed by sequence scalar extension to the scalar extension of both variables followed by SL.systemClosed.tensor, satisfying DerivedSigmaModel on every pair of flat-term K-flat representatives. This is the existing derivedSigma_existsUnique theorem, relocated unchanged; the original module publicly re-exports it.

source.place: Tags 07A4 and 0941; original proof step 8 of lem-pur-scalar-extension-tower-coherence, normalization of the actual completed scalar comparisons.

proof.text: For derivedSigma_existsUnique, let Good be flat-term K-flat sequence complexes. K-flat resolutions show that their images resolve every object of the homotopy category, so restriction of bifunctors to pairs of Good representatives is fully faithful. Change of rings preserves Good without requiring flatness of the coefficient map. Apply tensor-comparison descent to the two specified system tensor models, the universal scalar cochain counit, and the uniquely normalized strict sigma. This gives existence and uniqueness of the exact DerivedSigmaModel equation.

theorem derivedSigma_existsUnique (W : Scheme.{u})
    (SE : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l E W)
    (SL : CoefficientDerivedSystemCalculus.{u, u} l L W) :
    ∃! α : SE.systemClosed.tensor ⋙ integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W ≅
      (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W).prod
        (integralComparisonDerivedSequenceScalar.{u, u} l E L ι W) ⋙ SL.systemClosed.tensor,
      DerivedSigmaModel l E L ι W SE SL α
